gm_motif: perfect core-shell polyicosahedron pIh7 (D5h): Cu7 pentagonal bipyramid, every Cu an icosahedral centre (CN 12), 27 Ag shell atoms (coordination 12x6, 5x8, 10x9)
notes: Pilot: 10 BH + 10 RS seeds at 100000 steps (campaign pilot-bcl1). The NEP89 GM is exactly the core-shell polyicosahedron found with the Gupta potential (Rossi et al., PRL 93, 105503 (2004)); the hand-built reference relaxes to the same structure. The search covers geometry and Ag/Cu ordering (homotops). RS never got within 1.4 eV (median gap 2.47 eV). The 10 BH hits are identical (spread 0.2 meV), so e_tol = 0.02. Final budget 100000 = 3 x median BH hit step (33243), rounded; all BH pilot hits were at <= 76149 steps.
